cards.title: Approval protocol (Jonny policy)
cards.description:
Policy: If Jonny explicitly asks for something → theclaw auto-executes (including shipping code).
If theclaw proposes/creates something Jonny didn’t ask for → requires Jonny approval first.

Approvals happen in Telegram (e.g. ‘Approved ✅ #ID’).

cards.title: Validate 3 business ideas (48-hour discovery sprint)
cards.description:
Outcome: pick ONE best bet to pursue next week.

Proposed plan (once approved):
1) I draft 10 ideas + scoring rubric (market pain, willingness to pay, distribution edge, speed to MVP).
2) We shortlist to 3 ideas and define a tiny test for each (landing page, offer, outreach script).
3) I produce copy + assets for tests; you approve any outreach/posting; then we run the tests and pick a winner.
